# Continue Rust Evolution

For any new development session, read:

1. `AGENTS.md`
2. `docs/PROJECT_STATE.md`
3. `docs/NEXT_ACTION.md`
4. active issue/PR/Actions listed there

Do not ask the user to reconstruct prior chat history when repository access is available.

GitHub is the durable memory; `docs/NEXT_ACTION.md` is the single volatile continuation pointer.
